# Leaf spring and shackle repair

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Remove upper shock mount nuts, replace front leaf spring mount bolts and clean shackle nuts with grease. [t466]

[Partial] Remove the bolt from the dual air auxiliary leaf assembly, run it down through the stock leaf spring pack, then up through the AAL. [t947]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Remove the upper shock mount nuts.
2. Replace the front leaf spring mount bolts.
3. Remove and replace the shackle nuts to clean off baked-on bushing material.

_Procedure reported by [t466]._

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t947] [Partial]</summary>

1. Remove the bolt from the dual air auxiliary leaf (AAL) assembly.
2. [Partial] Run the bolt down through the stock leaf spring pack and then up through the AAL.

</details>

## Parts

- Front leaf spring mount bolt (54459-EA00A) [t466]
- Shackle nut (08918-3421A) [t466]
- Upper shock mount nut (08912-7421A) [t466]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use grease on the bushings. [t466]
- Consider replacing the shackle itself instead of scraping old bushing material off. [t466]
